title: Jacobi's trace identity: Σ_i det(u with column i replaced by A u_i) = tr(A)·det(u) (parent fact F3)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let A : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ be ℝ-linear (ℝⁿ = Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), and let u : Fin n → ℝⁿ. For v : Fin n → ℝⁿ write D(v) := det(Matrix.of fun k j => v j k), the determinant of the n×n matrix whose j-th column is v j. Then Σ_{i ∈ Fin n} D(Function.update u i (A(u i))) = tr(A)·D(u), where tr(A) = LinearMap.trace ℝ ℝⁿ A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid n) (u : Fin n → Euclid n), ∑ i : Fin n, Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => Function.update u i (A (u i)) j k) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) A * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => u j k)
